name: Brian Mast
desc: American politician and United States Army veteran
summary: Brian Jeffrey Mast (born July 10, 1980) is an American politician and veteran serving as the U.S. representative for Florida's 21st congressional district since 2017. The district, numbered as the 18th district before the 2020 redistricting cycle, includes the Treasure Coast and northern portions of Palm Beach County. He is a member of the Republican Party.
